verdict.reason: The source says 54% of edge vulnerabilities were fully remediated (vs. 38% for the CISA KEV catalog and 9% for all scanned vulnerabilities) and a 32-day median, but frames this as 'good news' and 'proper prioritization'. The claim reverses that into a negative conclusion, 'Organizations with security teams don't keep up', which the source never states. The 9% is also a comparison figure for all scanned vulnerabilities, not edge devices.
